dedupe_keys.name: synthetic smart home energy consumption generation and peer transactions

description: This deposit contains generated electricity consumption and production for groups of twenty, fifty, one hundred and two hundred smart homes. Rabie Ramadan and collaborators provide five synthetic cases, including a fifty-home case based on weather in Hail, northern Saudi Arabia. The article describes a 365-day horizon, and repository metadata identify peer-to-peer energy transactions as a supported use. Mendeley lists ten CSV files free under CC BY 4.0. These are simulated household trajectories, not observed meter records or confirmed real trading behaviour. The short repository documentation does not establish a common subdaily sampling interval or validate the synthetic distributions against a representative population. A reviewer-assessed use is testing local energy sharing, demand prediction or household-agent rules. model-pypsa offers related electricity optimization, and model-occdem-occupancy-demand-profiles provides another household-demand modelling approach. No CSV, security algorithm or energy-trading simulation was executed.
